definition: The sport of competing in speed.
examples: He loves car racing.
She watches horse racing.
He wants to be a racing driver.

spanish.definition: Deporte de competir en velocidad.

definition: Not often.
examples: I rarely eat meat.
He rarely calls his mother.
It rarely snows here.

spanish.definition: No muy a menudo.

definition: A shape with four sides and four right angles.
examples: Draw a rectangle on the paper.
A door is shaped like a rectangle.
The table is a long rectangle.

spanish.definition: Forma con cuatro lados y cuatro ángulos rectos.

definition: A person who reads.
examples: She's a fast reader.
The magazine has a million readers.
My son is a good reader for his age.

spanish.definition: Persona que lee.

definition: The activity of looking at and understanding written words.
examples: Reading is my favorite hobby.
I do my reading on the train.
She has a reading problem.

spanish.definition: Actividad de mirar y entender palabras escritas.

definition: About.
examples: I'm calling regarding your order.
We have questions regarding the contract.
She got a letter regarding her taxes.

spanish.definition: Sobre un tema.

definition: Often, at the same times.
examples: I exercise regularly.
She regularly visits her grandmother.
Clean the filter regularly.

spanish.definition: A menudo, a las mismas horas.

definition: To show a connection; to understand someone's feelings.
examples: This relates to what we discussed.
I can't relate to her problems.
Kids relate better to young teachers.

spanish.definition: Mostrar una conexión; entender los sentimientos de alguien.

definition: Compared to other things.
examples: The test was relatively easy.
It's a relatively small town.
Prices here are relatively low.

spanish.definition: Comparado con otras cosas.

definition: Calm and not worried.
examples: She looked very relaxed.
It's a relaxed place to work.
I feel relaxed after yoga.

spanish.definition: Tranquilo y sin preocupaciones.

definition: Still left.
examples: We spent the remaining money on food.
The remaining guests went home.
He ate the remaining cookies.

spanish.definition: Que todavía queda.

definition: Things left after other parts are gone; a dead body.
examples: We visited the remains of an old castle.
They found human remains in the woods.
The remains of dinner were on the table.

spanish.definition: Lo que queda cuando otras partes se han ido; cadáver.

definition: Something that helps you remember.
examples: I set a reminder on my phone.
This is a reminder to pay your bill.
The photo is a reminder of that summer.

spanish.definition: Algo que te ayuda a recordar.

definition: A promise to yourself; the quality of an image.
examples: My New Year's resolution is to exercise more.
This screen has a high resolution.
The UN passed a resolution.

spanish.definition: Promesa que te haces; calidad de una imagen.

definition: To limit something.
examples: The new law restricts smoking.
Doctors restricted his diet.
They're restricting the number of visitors.

spanish.definition: Limitar algo.

definition: A rule that limits something.
examples: There are travel restrictions this year.
The airline has weight restrictions on bags.
They lifted the restrictions in June.

spanish.definition: Regla que limita algo.

definition: A person on a horse or a bike.
examples: The rider fell off the horse.
She's a good motorcycle rider.
Bike riders must wear helmets.

spanish.definition: Persona sobre un caballo o una bicicleta.

definition: A person who steals.
examples: The bank robbers escaped.
A robber took her purse.
Police caught the robber last night.

spanish.definition: Persona que roba.

definition: A long tool for measuring; a person who controls a country.
examples: Draw a line with your ruler.
He was a cruel ruler.
I need a ruler for my math class.

spanish.definition: Herramienta larga para medir; persona que controla un país.

definition: A person who runs.
examples: She's a fast runner.
Thousands of runners joined the marathon.
He's a long-distance runner.

spanish.definition: Persona que corre.

definition: A sport played with an oval ball.
examples: He plays rugby at college.
Rugby is popular in New Zealand.
She broke her nose playing rugby.

spanish.definition: Deporte que se juega con una pelota ovalada.

definition: In a sad way; unfortunately.
examples: Sadly, he died last year.
She looked at me sadly.
Sadly, the store is closing.

spanish.definition: De una manera triste; lamentablemente.

definition: Covered with sand.
examples: We walked along the sandy beach.
My shoes are sandy.
The kids came back with sandy feet.

spanish.definition: Cubierto de arena.

definition: A small plate under a cup.
examples: She put the cup on a saucer.
The cat drank milk from a saucer.
He says he saw a flying saucer.

spanish.definition: Plato pequeño debajo de una taza.

definition: Money you keep; an amount you don't spend.
examples: She put her savings in the bank.
He spent all of his savings on a car.
That's a saving of ten dollars.

spanish.definition: Dinero que guardas; cantidad que no gastas.

definition: Afraid.
examples: Don't be scared.
I'm scared of spiders.
She was too scared to speak.

spanish.definition: Con miedo.

definition: To throw things in different directions.
examples: She scattered seeds on the ground.
The toys were scattered across the floor.
The birds scattered when the dog came.

spanish.definition: Tirar cosas en distintas direcciones.

definition: To speak angrily to someone who did something wrong.
examples: My mother scolded me for being late.
Don't scold the dog.
The teacher is scolding the boys.

spanish.definition: Hablarle con enojo a alguien que hizo algo mal.

definition: To choose.
examples: Select a color from the menu.
She was selected for the team.
We're selecting a new manager.

spanish.definition: Escoger.

definition: A person who serves food; a computer that stores data for others.
examples: Our server was very friendly.
The server is down this morning.
Ask the server for the check.

spanish.definition: Persona que sirve comida; computadora que guarda datos para otras.

definition: Very surprising and upsetting.
examples: The news was shocking.
It's shocking how much rent costs here.
She told me a shocking story.

spanish.definition: Muy sorprendente y perturbador.

definition: The activity of buying things in stores.
examples: We went shopping on Saturday.
I do my shopping online.
Let's meet at the shopping center.

spanish.definition: Actividad de comprar cosas en tiendas.

definition: To lift your shoulders to show you don't know or don't care.
examples: He just shrugged and walked away.
She shrugged her shoulders.
Don't shrug at me; answer the question.

spanish.definition: Subir los hombros para mostrar que no sabes o no te importa.

definition: Good at something.
examples: He's a skilled carpenter.
We need more skilled workers.
She's very skilled at her job.

spanish.definition: Bueno para algo.

definition: A small vehicle for moving over snow.
examples: The kids went down the hill on a sled.
Dogs pulled the sled.
We got a sled for Christmas.

spanish.definition: Vehículo pequeño para moverse sobre la nieve.

definition: The habit of breathing in smoke from cigarettes.
examples: Smoking is bad for your health.
There's no smoking in the building.
He gave up smoking last year.

spanish.definition: Hábito de inhalar humo de cigarrillos.

definition: The correct order of letters in a word.
examples: Check your spelling.
American spelling is different from British spelling.
She won the spelling bee.

spanish.definition: Orden correcto de las letras en una palabra.

definition: One of a set of steps inside a building.
examples: He ran up the stairs.
Be careful on the stairs.
She sat on the bottom stair.

spanish.definition: Uno de los pasos de una escalera dentro de un edificio.

definition: The parts that control the direction of a car.
examples: Keep both hands on the steering wheel.
The steering on this car is very light.
There's a problem with the steering.

spanish.definition: Partes que controlan la dirección de un carro.

definition: An area with homes outside a big city.
examples: They live in a suburb of Chicago.
We moved to the suburbs.
I grew up in the suburbs.

spanish.definition: Zona con casas afuera de una ciudad grande.

definition: The top of a mountain; a meeting of leaders.
examples: We reached the summit at noon.
The presidents met at a summit in Geneva.
There's snow on the summit.

spanish.definition: Parte más alta de una montaña; reunión de líderes.

definition: A company that provides goods.
examples: We changed our paper supplier.
They're the country's biggest gas supplier.
Our supplier raised its prices.

spanish.definition: Empresa que suministra productos.

definition: A person who likes and helps a team or a person.
examples: She's a strong supporter of the mayor.
The team's supporters filled the stadium.
He's a loyal supporter of the school.

spanish.definition: Persona que apoya a un equipo o a alguien.

definition: Expected or required.
examples: You're supposed to call first.
It's supposed to rain tomorrow.
What am I supposed to do?

spanish.definition: Esperado o requerido.

definition: Not expected.
examples: The results are surprising.
It's not surprising that he's tired.
She made a surprising decision.

spanish.definition: Que no se esperaba.

definition: A large spoon; the amount it holds.
examples: Add a tablespoon of oil.
Use two tablespoons of sugar.
The recipe calls for one tablespoon of butter.

spanish.definition: Cuchara grande; cantidad que contiene.

definition: A small spoon; the amount it holds.
examples: Add a teaspoon of salt.
I take one teaspoon of sugar in my coffee.
She stirred her tea with a teaspoon.

spanish.definition: Cuchara pequeña; cantidad que contiene.

definition: To make someone very afraid.
examples: Spiders terrify me.
The storm terrified the kids.
The noise is terrifying the dog.

spanish.definition: Hacer que alguien tenga mucho miedo.

definition: A vehicle pulled by a car; a short ad for a movie.
examples: He pulled the boat on a trailer.
Did you see the trailer for the new movie?
They live in a trailer.

spanish.definition: Vehículo jalado por un carro; anuncio corto de una película.

definition: A person who teaches people or animals skills.
examples: I work with a personal trainer.
The trainer taught the dog to sit.
She's a fitness trainer.

spanish.definition: Persona que enseña habilidades a personas o animales.

definition: The process of learning skills for a job or a sport.
examples: New workers get two weeks of training.
He's in training for the marathon.
She has training as a nurse.

spanish.definition: Proceso de aprender habilidades para un trabajo o un deporte.

definition: A person who travels.
examples: Airports are full of tired travelers.
She's a frequent traveler.
The hotel is popular with business travelers.

spanish.definition: Persona que viaja.

definition: Usually.
examples: I typically get up at seven.
The trip typically takes two hours.
Summers here are typically hot.

spanish.definition: Normalmente.

definition: Joined together.
examples: The family stayed united.
We're united against crime.
The players were united as a team.

spanish.definition: Juntos como uno.

definition: Not new; familiar with something.
examples: We bought a used car.
I'm used to the cold.
She's selling used books.

spanish.definition: Que no es nuevo; acostumbrado a algo.

definition: A person who uses something.
examples: The app has a million users.
Enter your user name.
Bus users complained about the delay.

spanish.definition: Persona que usa algo.

definition: Through; by using.
examples: We flew to Lima via Bogotá.
I sent it via email.
You can pay via the app.

spanish.definition: A través de; usando.

definition: A person who watches something.
examples: The show has ten million viewers.
Viewers called to complain.
TV viewers saw the whole thing live.

spanish.definition: Persona que mira algo.

definition: A person who votes.
examples: Most voters want change.
She's a registered voter.
Voters went to the polls on Tuesday.

spanish.definition: Persona que vota.

definition: To make a serious promise; a serious promise.
examples: He vowed to come back.
They wrote their own wedding vows.
She vowed never to speak to him again.

spanish.definition: Hacer una promesa seria; promesa seria.

definition: In a friendly way; in a way that keeps you warm.
examples: She greeted us warmly.
Dress warmly; it's cold outside.
They welcomed me warmly.

spanish.definition: De manera amistosa; de manera que te mantenga caliente.

definition: Any day from Monday to Friday.
examples: The store is open on weekdays.
I get up early on weekdays.
The bus runs every weekday.

spanish.definition: Cualquier día de lunes a viernes.

definition: Happening once a week.
examples: We have a weekly meeting.
I get paid weekly.
She writes a weekly column.

spanish.definition: Que pasa una vez a la semana.

definition: Used to show a difference between two things.
examples: He's tall, whereas his brother is short.
She loves the city, whereas I prefer the country.
Some people work hard, whereas others don't.

spanish.definition: Se usa para mostrar la diferencia entre dos cosas.

definition: All of something.
examples: He ate the whole pizza.
I slept the whole day.
The whole family was there.

spanish.definition: Todo de algo.

definition: By many people; in many places.
examples: English is widely spoken here.
The book is widely available.
She's widely known as a great cook.

spanish.definition: Por mucha gente; en muchos lugares.

definition: Unhappy because you think something bad may happen.
examples: I'm worried about my son.
She looks worried.
Don't be worried; everything is fine.

spanish.definition: Infeliz porque crees que algo malo puede pasar.

definition: Words on paper; the activity of creating texts.
examples: I can't read your writing.
She makes a living from her writing.
He teaches creative writing.

spanish.definition: Palabras en papel; actividad de crear textos.

definition: To produce something; to let other cars go first.
examples: Yield to cars coming from the left.
The farm yields good crops.
The research yielded useful results.

spanish.definition: Producir algo; dejar pasar primero a otros carros.

definition: Soft and easy to cut; gentle and loving.
examples: The steak is very tender.
She gave him a tender kiss.
My arm is still tender.

spanish.definition: Suave y fácil de cortar; delicado y cariñoso.

definition: To experience something difficult.
examples: He underwent heart surgery.
The town has undergone many changes.
She's undergoing treatment.

spanish.definition: Vivir algo difícil.

definition: Not nice to people.
examples: The waiter was unfriendly.
They're very unfriendly neighbors.
He gave me an unfriendly look.

spanish.definition: Que no es amable con la gente.

definition: Probably not going to happen.
examples: It's unlikely to rain today.
He's unlikely to win.
It's an unlikely story.

spanish.definition: Que probablemente no va a pasar.

definition: Coming right after this one.
examples: See you next week.
Who's next in line?
What should we do next?

spanish.definition: Que viene justo después de este.

definition: Of a higher quality; less sick.
examples: This pizza is better than the last one.
I feel better today.
She sings better than I do.

spanish.definition: De mayor calidad; menos enfermo.

definition: A person or a living thing.
examples: We're all human beings.
The movie is about beings from another planet.
No human being can live without water.

spanish.definition: Persona o ser vivo.

definition: Unable to find your way; missing.
examples: We got lost in the woods.
I found my lost wallet.
Are you lost?

spanish.definition: Que no encuentra el camino; desaparecido.

definition: Used after neither to add another negative.
examples: He neither called nor wrote.
I don't smoke, nor do I drink.
She's neither rich nor famous.

spanish.definition: Se usa después de neither para sumar otra negación.

definition: A piece of furniture with shelves for books.
examples: The bookcase covers the whole wall.
I built a small bookcase.
Put the dictionary back in the bookcase.

spanish.definition: Mueble con estantes para libros.

definition: A shelf for books.
examples: There's a photo on the bookshelf.
My bookshelf is full of novels.
He built a bookshelf for his office.

spanish.definition: Estante para libros.

definition: Something to mark your place in a book; to save a web page.
examples: I lost my bookmark.
She bookmarked the website.
He used a receipt as a bookmark.

spanish.definition: Algo para marcar tu lugar en un libro; guardar una página web.

definition: A board that holds papers; the place on a computer for copied text.
examples: The nurse carried a clipboard.
He signed the form on a clipboard.
The text was copied to the clipboard.

spanish.definition: Tabla que sostiene papeles; lugar de la computadora para el texto copiado.

definition: A heavy pan for frying.
examples: Melt some butter in a skillet.
She cooked the eggs in an iron skillet.
Heat the skillet before you add the meat.

spanish.definition: Sartén pesada para freír.

definition: A deep pan with a long handle.
examples: Heat the milk in a saucepan.
The saucepan is on the stove.
He boiled the eggs in a small saucepan.

spanish.definition: Olla honda con mango largo.

definition: A book of recipes.
examples: She got a Mexican cookbook.
My mom has dozens of cookbooks.
I found this recipe in an old cookbook.

spanish.definition: Libro de recetas.

definition: A small box for carrying your lunch.
examples: He forgot his lunchbox at home.
She put an apple in her son's lunchbox.
My lunchbox has a robot on it.

spanish.definition: Caja pequeña para llevar el almuerzo.

definition: A brush for your hair.
examples: I can't find my hairbrush.
She used a hairbrush as a microphone.
There's a hairbrush in the bathroom.

spanish.definition: Cepillo para el pelo.

definition: A machine for washing clothes.
examples: Our washer is broken.
Put the towels in the washer.
The apartment has a washer and a dryer.

spanish.definition: Máquina para lavar ropa.

definition: A machine for drying clothes or hair.
examples: Move the clothes to the dryer.
The hair dryer stopped working.
My shirt shrank in the dryer.

spanish.definition: Máquina para secar la ropa o el pelo.

definition: A box in furniture that slides in and out.
examples: The knives are in the top drawer.
She opened the drawer.
My socks are in that drawer.

spanish.definition: Caja en un mueble que entra y sale.

definition: A piece of furniture with drawers for clothes.
examples: My keys are on the dresser.
The bedroom has a large dresser.
I keep my shirts in the dresser.

spanish.definition: Mueble con cajones para la ropa.

definition: A comfortable chair with sides for your arms.
examples: He fell asleep in his armchair.
There's a leather armchair by the fire.
Grandpa always sits in that armchair.

spanish.definition: Silla cómoda con lados para los brazos.

definition: A small table next to a bed.
examples: My phone is on the nightstand.
She keeps a book on her nightstand.
We bought a lamp for the nightstand.

spanish.definition: Mesa pequeña al lado de una cama.

definition: A mat at a door for cleaning your shoes.
examples: Wipe your feet on the doormat.
The key is under the doormat.
The doormat says "Welcome" on it.

spanish.definition: Tapete en una puerta para limpiarte los zapatos.

definition: A machine for making toast.
examples: Put the bread in the toaster.
The toaster burned my bread.
We got a toaster as a wedding gift.

spanish.definition: Máquina para tostar pan.

definition: A kitchen machine that mixes food into liquid.
examples: Put the fruit in the blender.
I make smoothies in my blender.
The blender is very loud.

spanish.definition: Máquina de cocina que mezcla la comida hasta dejarla líquida.

definition: A machine that keeps food frozen.
examples: There's ice cream in the freezer.
Put the meat in the freezer.
Our freezer is full.

spanish.definition: Máquina que mantiene congelada la comida.

definition: A kitchen tool with a wide, flat end.
examples: Turn the pancake with a spatula.
She scraped the bowl with a spatula.
I need a spatula for the eggs.

spanish.definition: Herramienta de cocina con un extremo ancho y plano.

definition: A tool that joins papers with small pieces of metal.
examples: Can I use your stapler?
The stapler is out of staples.
There's a stapler on my desk.

spanish.definition: Herramienta que une papeles con pedacitos de metal.

definition: A small object for removing pencil marks.
examples: Can I borrow your eraser?
This pencil has an eraser on the end.
The teacher cleaned the board with an eraser.

spanish.definition: Objeto pequeño para quitar marcas de lápiz.
